Treatments

Every treatment, documented in full.

Twenty-one treatments across dentistry and hair restoration. Each page carries the technique, the materials, the day-by-day procedure, the recovery timeline, the published evidence and the Istanbul price — so you can decide before you speak to anyone.

10 treatments

Oral surgery & implants

Immediate Dental Implants

Extraction and implant placement in a single appointment, leaving with fixed teeth the same day.

Read the guide

Single Dental Implants

Replace one missing tooth permanently, without touching the healthy teeth on either side.

Read the guide

Full Mouth Dental Implants

Complete arch restoration using the All-on-4 and All-on-6 techniques.

Read the guide

All-on-4 Dental Implants

A full fixed arch supported by four implants, placed and loaded in one visit.

Read the guide

All-on-6 Dental Implants

Six implants for greater load distribution and long-term stability.

Read the guide

Zygomatic Implants

For severe upper-jaw bone loss — anchored in the cheekbone, with no grafting required.

Read the guide

Bone Graft

Rebuilding jawbone volume so implants have a solid foundation.

Read the guide

Sinus Lift

Maxillary sinus augmentation to create implant height in the upper jaw.

Read the guide

Inlay & Onlay

Precision porcelain or zirconia restorations where a filling is not enough.

Read the guide

Night Guard

Custom-fitted protection against bruxism and TMJ strain.

Read the guide

E-max Lumineers

Hair restoration

Sapphire FUE

Sapphire-blade channel opening for denser packing and faster healing.

Read the guide

DHI Hair Transplant

Direct implantation with the Choi pen — no pre-opened channels, maximum control.

Read the guide

Manual FUE

Hand-held punch extraction for maximum graft-by-graft control.

Read the guide

OxyCure

Oxygen-assisted post-operative support protocol for graft survival.

Read the guide

Beard & Mustache Transplant

Facial hair restoration following the natural direction of beard growth.

Read the guide

Eyebrow Restoration

Single-hair grafting to rebuild eyebrow shape and density.

Read the guide

Female Hair Transplant

No-shave and partial-shave techniques designed for female pattern loss.

Read the guide

Not sure which treatment applies to you?

Send photographs and any recent X-rays. A partner dentist reviews them and tells you what is actually indicated — including when the answer is that you do not need what you asked about.
